name: Cash withdrawals match payroll amounts
description: Large cash withdrawals shortly after receiving client funds, close to total weekly wages, with no matching payroll tax payments.
fp: Genuine cash-in-hand wages exist in some sectors.

sources.text: OECD, Shining Light on the Shadow Economy: Opportunities and Threats (2017)
FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
ILO and tax authority guidance on undeclared work and bogus self-employment
